tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gsang sgrub kyi dbang chog byin rlabs myur 'jug bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// snying rje nyid kyis drag shul cher 'jigs pas// sdig can srog 'thor gzugs kyi phung po'i sde// zhal gyi dga' ston nyid du dgyes mdzad pa// mgon po'i mgon po de la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pa'i blo la mngon gyur pa// 'og min gtam gyi ge sar 'phreng*/ pad dkar khong gnas bstan rag zhes// bskul ba'i nyi ma deng 'dir byon// 'dir slob dpon rtsa mis mdzad pa'i gsang sgrub kyi dbang chog phyis chos skyong nyid kyis dpal rga lo la dngos su gdams pas kha bskang ste bshad par bya'o// de la me long la sin+dhu ras chos 'byung gi dbyibs bris/ nang du waṃ yig mañdzi'i kha'i thod pa chang gis bkang ba/ de'i steng du bum pa bzang po bsham/ mdun gyi grur sgrub gtor/g.yas su las byed drag gtor/ g.yon du mchod gtor/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ tshogs kyi mchod pas kyang bdar te/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed/ tshogs zhing*/ tshad med/ stong nyid kyi ngang las bdag nyid gsang sgrub bzhin gyi gtso 'khor du bskyed/ bum pa ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang*/ nang du bdag bskyed bzhin gyi gtso 'khor/ ka pā lar ā li kā li sngags yi ge gsum gyis thog mtha' brgyan pa sin+dhu ra yum tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i mkha'/ bde chen ye shes waṃ gyi rnam par zhugs pa/ sgrub gtor gtso bo yab yum/ drag gtor las mgon du bskyed/ spyan drangs bstim/ dbang bskur/ rgyas btab/ mchod bstod kyis mnyes par byas/ mdun bskyed bskul ba'i sngags tshan gsum bzlas/ de nas slob ma mdun du bos/ khrus byas/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor byas/ dus bzhi gnad bzhi kha dog bzhi// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod las// gnas skabs dang ni mthar thug dbang*// bdag la legs par stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon dpal ye shes kyi mgon por gsal btab pa'i spyan sngar/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// sogs kyis skyabs 'gro/

ji ltar dus gsum sogs kyis sems bskyed sbyin/ slob ma ye shes kyi mgon por bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bsil ba'i tshal la sogs pa nas dpal ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor bcas gnam nas kha ba babs pa lta bu/ sa nas sa rlangs 'byung ba lta bu/ bar nas bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bur byon pa slob ma la thim par bsams te/ rol mo drag tu brdung*/ gu gul 'thul/ bcu bdun pa'i mthar dzñā na a be sha ya āḥ.aḥ zhes pas dngos su sku phebs nas gar/ gsung brda skad/ thugs ting nge 'dzin nam snang ba thams cad zi long a mthas kyi snang ba zhig pa 'byung*/ de ni dkyil 'khor du gsal bas 'jug pa'am byin dbab pa'o// de nas bum pa lag tu thogs te/ bum pa'i lha las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje spyan drangs/ de nyid la thim/ skad cig gis bde mchog rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas ye shes kyi bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa gyis/ byas/ bum pa'i dbang bskur dam pa 'dis// lus kyi sgrib pa sbyangs nas su// lha yi de nyid mngon gyur pa'i// sku yi rdo rje 'grub gyur cig/ bcu bdun pa'i mthar/ ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ lha tshogs zhu ba'i bum pa'i chus phyi nang bkrus/ sad pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ dwangs ma 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur pa'i nang du rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga gsal ba/ chu rgyun spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i dbus su sku'i mgon po zla ba chu shel lta bur dkar zhing zhi ba'i las rab 'byams dang tshe'i mchog stsol ba'i mthu stobs kyi gter du gyur pa bzhugs par bsam/ de nas ka pā la lag tu thogs te/ ā li kā li las 'od 'phros/ gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags thams cad bsdus/ de nyid la thim/ dbang lha'i bde mchog rigs lnga snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems dkar dmar 'dres pa babs pa des dbang bskur bar

bsam/ ngag tu/ byang chub sems kyis dbang bskur bas// ngag gi sgrib pa sbyangs nas su// sngags kyi de nyid mngon gyur pa'i// gsung gi rdo rje thob gyur cig/ sngags mthar/ bo dhi tsit+ta sbyar ba 'dzab tu 'dren/ ā li kā li zhu ba'i byang sems dkar dmar lce brgyud mgrin pa'i 'khor lo gang*/ rmi lam gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ rlung 'byung 'jug thams cad sngags kyi bzlas brjod du gyur/ dbang rtags mgrin par gsung gi mgon po li khri zhun ma byugs pa lta bu/ dbang gi las rab 'byams dang*/ tshig gi mchog stsol ba'i mthu stobs kyi gter du gyur pa bzhugs par bsam/ de nas sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor khyer te/ mkha' dbyings yum gyi dbang bskur bas// yid kyi sgrib pa sbyangs nas su// phyag rgya'i de nyid mngon gyur pa'i// thugs kyi rdo rje thob gyur cig/ sngags mthar/ dzñā dzñā na sbyar/ 'khor lo lus la zhugs/ snang ba yun gyi mkhar rang rig bde ba'i waṃ gyis snyoms par zhugs pas/ gnyid stug gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin thams cad mngon du gyur/ dbang rtags snying ga'i 'khor lo'i dbus su thugs kyi mgon po mthing shun dri ma med pa lta bu mchog dngos grub pa'i mthu stobs kyi gter du gyur pa bzhugs par bsam/ de nas gtor ma thogs te/ ba liṃ gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas// rnam shes khams rnams sbyangs byas nas// ye shes lnga po mngon gyur pas// thams cad sangs rgyas nyid gyur cig/ sngags mthar/ ma hā mu dra a sbyar/ gtor ma'i lha tshogs 'od du zhu gnyis su med par thim pas/ snyoms 'jug gi dri ma sbyangs/ ye shes lnga mngon du gyur pas/ dbang rtags lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor rin chen mgon po rgyas pa'i byin chags pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan thams cad stsol ba'i stobs kyi gter du gyur pa bzhugs par bsam/ de nas drag gtor lag tu thogs te/

chos skyong kun gyi drag po'i dbang*// skal ldan khyod la bskur ba 'dis// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// 'phrin las thams cad 'grub gyur cig/ sngags mthar/ karma a sbyar/ dbang rtags gsang gnas su 'phrin las kyi mgon po margad kyi mdangs can/ bya rog gdong la sogs pa ye shes kyi mgon po dang las kyi mgon po sde brgyad thams cad kyis ci bsgo ba'i bka' nyan zhing dam la gnas te gdug pa can thams cad bsgral/ sha khrag tshogs kyi yo byad du byas par bsam la/ lha mi bsgom pa lus kyi dam tshig sngags mi bgrang ba ngag gi ting nge 'dzin mi bsgom pa yid kyi/ gtor ma mi btang ba rdzas kyi/ 'phrin las mi bskul ba rnal 'byor gyi dam tshig ste/ ye nas lus lha/ ngag sngags/ yid ting nge 'dzin/ snang srid gtor rdzas/ gang la gang gis 'dul ba de der 'char ba'i phyir ro// tshogs la rol/ lhag ma btang*/ slob dpon yon gyis mnyes par bya'o// zhes gsang sgrub dang 'brel ba'i dbang chog byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba 'di/ dpal 'brug pa zhes yongs su grags pa'i dbon rin po che ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi mas bskul ba ltar/ dge slong gsang ba sbyin pa pad+ma dkar pos 'ol dga' stag rtse'i sgang du bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ/// /
